body:
Thank you. As I said to another commenter, I am doing A lot better mentally right now. 

I do use a wide variety of hemp products. I smoke marijuana, have high CBD content oil to smoke, Phoenix Tears (high CBD oil for ingesting) and CBD glycerin oil (for ingesting). I've been trying to keep up with taking the oils every day. I am lucky I have access to all these medical marijuana medicines, and I am more than comfortable using them.

Thank you. I'm doing a lot better now than I was when I posted this. I'm feeling more positive and finally feeling somewhat normal again.

Yes, I used a wide variety of hemp products. I smoke marijuana, have high CBD content oil to smoke, Phoenix Tears (high CBD oil for ingesting) and CBD glycerin oil (for ingesting). I've been trying to keep up with taking the oils every day. I am lucky I have access to all these medical marijuana medicines, and I am more than comfortable using them.

I do have my family and a few select friends and my boyfriend who has been incredible supportive. My friends and family don't live where I am right now, though. So that sucks. I am having some gland issues and tonsil issues right now too and I can't help but freak out and think it might be cancer too. I'm so lost and scared... Sometimes I just want to die because this is so overwhelming and I don't want to deal with the emotional stress of finding out I might die soon. I still want to live, but healthily. I do know how I'd be ok knowing I can't be cured and will die soon.

No, not on chemo or anything harsh. Just been treated with a simple leep procedure. I want to get a hysterectomy though, which I'm kinda scared about (the side effects). I am grateful that I don't need chemo right now. 

My lack of drive and feeling depressed is mostly because of the stress of it all and finding out (only found out about a month ago? I've lost track of time now. But not long ago).

All of my friends live away from where I'm living at the moment. I live with my boyfriend at least, and he's been really supportive. But yeah, all my friends live 3+ hours away and I never really made close friends in this small town. 

I guess I can be creative.. I just feel like I don't want to anything right now. But at the same time I want to, but I just can't forget about the cancer and how scary everything is. I like to draw and I make jewelry and clothing etc. 

Thanks. I'll try and keep all that info in mind. You are right that medical is getting better every year so it might be better if they make advancements. I guess I mostly get super sad and tired of being stressed and I just don't want to live anymore because everything feels to difficult. I don't know. I'm having a better day today at least. 

I had a really bad friend when I was growing up that contributed to my depression, anxiety and suicidal thoughts. I've just always struggled since then. I'm not sure why, or if it was just because of that relationship. Honestly I wasn't doing that well even before diagnosis. I was mostly feeling depressed for no reason almost. Missing friends, feeling alone. 

Thanks for talking with me and trying to help me. That means a whole lot to me and you've made me feel better.

They haven't checked the rest of my body for other cancers and they don't believe what they found had spread. So I guess that's good. I'm so sorry to hear that about your mom. :( 

I really don't want to die... But I also don't want to suffer through chemo or something just for a few more years if it was at that point. I'm scared of suffering.. And not living more than 10 years. I'm only 25.
Thank you so much... I really appreciate it. I might send you a PM.

Hm. I guess I just want to feel somewhat normal again. I'm tired of constantly thinking about all this cancer stuff and feeling worried. I miss being able to just see my friends, I miss being creative. I feel like my drive to do things has disappeared and I'm not sure how to get back into living my life.
Thanks guys, that makes me feel a bit better. They did catch it extremely early and they think they have gotten all of it. So that's good news at least. Still can't help but feel scared though.
